description: Menus, sheets and questions. One menu is open at a time; opening another replaces it. With an `anchor` it is a popover beside that control on a wide screen; on a phone, or with no anchor, it is a bottom sheet. Focus moves in on open, Tab stays inside, Escape and a click outside close it, and focus returns to whatever opened it. `modal` and `confirm` ask a question instead: always a centred dialog (a bottom sheet on a phone), never a popover, and they resolve with the answer.
